Stellar Glimmer Reaction

Type

Combat
Game Systems

Group

Elemental Reactions

Stellar Glimmer Reactions are a subset of Elemental Reactions.

In order to trigger a Stellar Glimmer Reaction, a character with a passive talent that converts specific Cryo-related elemental reactions must be present in the party.

Stellar Glimmer reactions will also interrupt a specific attack from Snowland Fae and Aberrant Chimeric Monsters.

Artifacts[]

1 Artifact Set increase Stellar Glimmer Reaction DMG:

Set Rarity Pieces Bonuses
Heart of the Furnace 4-5★ 2-Piece: ATK increased by 18%.
4-Piece: Increases the equipping character's ATK by 12% for 12s when they trigger a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deal Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Also increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members by 50%. The above effects can trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field, and the DMG bonus from multiple Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.

Lore[]

Stellar Glimmer Reactions were introduced to ancient Snezhnaya by Saarelainen.[1]
